description: This file contains the main activity class for an Android application demonstrating the use of LayoutTransition animations. It includes a nested custom view class and handles user interactions to animate layout changes.

classes.name: LayoutTransChanging
classes.description: Main activity class that manages a linear layout with animated add/remove actions for its child views.

classes.name: ColoredView
classes.description: A custom view that toggles size and color when clicked, animated via LayoutTransition.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and configures layout transition animations.

methods.name: ColoredView (constructor)
methods.description: Creates a colored square view that changes size on click.
